PAN AMERICAN TRANS-PACIFIC "STRATO" CLIPPERS now arrive
and depart from San Francisco's new multi-million dollar Inter-
national Air Terminal, providing faster, more convenient connections
with flights to and from all parts of the U.S... the world. Ready to
serve you are Pan Am's new passenger service counter for informa-
tion and reservations... improved baggage-handling facilities...
and new, specially-designed Clipper Cargo facilities.

he DECKED Strato Clipper
Never before has so much Confor order much in atry

Clippers, Pan American has incorporated more than 1,000 im-
provements in the fields of service, maintenance and operation
into their original design.
Everything, yes everything, has been done to provide you with
service unmatched in the field of commercial aviation.
QUICK FACTS...
• First plane ever designed with a lower-deck club lounge—
spiral staircase leads you down to complete change of scene.
• Flies in smooth sky
"above the weather." Cabin maintains
low-level air pressure even at 25,000 feet.
• Both decks air
conditioned and pressurized. Cabin air
changes every 90 seconds.
• The four Pratt & Whitney engines develop 14,000 horse-
power... more powerful than a locomotive.
• Individual sleeping
accommodations for everyone-your
choice of Pan American's exclusive Sleeperette Service or
berth. By day: Sleeperette is a luxurious lounge chair quickly
adjustable to several comfortable positions. By night: Sleep-
erette reclines to full bed-length. Or if you prefer ... a
large, single occupancy berth — wider than a railroad car's.
(Additional charge for berth.)
